name: android-wireless-companion
displayName: Android App in VS Code — SUVIDHA
description: Launches SUVIDHA on an independent Android Virtual Display using scrcpy (sleep-friendly, offline).

suvidha.appName.markdownDescription: Display name of the Android app shown in the panel title, sidebar, status bar, and prompts.

suvidha.appPackage.markdownDescription: Android package name of the app to launch (for example `com.example.myapp`). Used by `am start`, `am force-stop`, and the launcher intent. Changing it while the screen is open reconnects and launches the new app.

suvidha.virtualDisplay.markdownDescription: Run SUVIDHA on its own virtual display instead of mirroring the phone screen. The app stays usable while the phone's screen is off or locked.

suvidha.keepActive.markdownDescription: Keep the phone awake while the panel is open (scrcpy simulates user activity to reset the screen timeout). Without it, the phone sleeps and Android powers off the virtual display.

suvidha.inDisplayScrollbar.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the in-display scrollbar on the right edge of the phone screen.

suvidha.androidProjectDir.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Android project directory containing `gradlew`. Leave empty to use the currently open VS Code workspace directory.
